tagline:

Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] You don't need more willpower to stop checking your phone. You need distance. || Every time it buzzes, picking it up takes one second. And one second is all your brain needs to say yes. || [turn] So make it harder. Put the phone in another room, close the door, and start a twenty five minute timer on your laptop. || Now checking it means standing up and walking to the door. That little pause is usually enough to keep you working. || Say you're studying for an exam. One block, twenty pages. A second block, twenty more. Phone in the kitchen both times. || When the timer ends, take a five minute break. Check whatever you want. Then go again. || [land] Pick the room right now. Tomorrow, your first block starts with the phone in the kitchen. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
